PRNG keys

Source: R/random.R
random_key.Rd

Ports of the key functions of jax.random. random_key() returns a typed key array (a scalar array of keys whose dtype names the PRNG implementation, key<fry> for threefry2x32); random_PRNGKey() returns a legacy raw key, a uint32 array of shape 2. Both are accepted by all samplers. Typed key arrays are pytrees: they pass through jit(), vmap() and grad() (with float0 tangents), can be indexed with [ and split into a list with as.list().

Usage

random_key(seed, impl = NULL, dtype = NULL)

random_PRNGKey(seed, impl = NULL)

random_fold_in(key, data)

random_split(key, num = 2L)

random_key_impl(keys)

random_key_data(keys)

random_wrap_key_data(key_bits_array, impl = NULL, dtype = NULL)

random_key_dtype(impl_spec = NULL)

random_clone(key)

random_Key(x)

Arguments

seed

An integer scalar (an R whole number or an integer jax scalar). R numbers are treated as Python ints: they wrap to 32 bits unless x64 is enabled.

impl

Optional PRNG implementation name.

dtype

Optional key dtype (as returned by random_key_dtype()) or implementation name; an alternative to impl.

key, keys

A key (typed or raw) or key array.

data

A 32-bit integer scalar to fold into the key.

num

Number of keys (or shape of the key array) to produce.

key_bits_array

A uint32 array whose trailing dimensions are the key shape of the implementation.

impl_spec

Optional implementation name.

x

A value (returned unchanged by random_Key()).

Value

random_key(), random_split(), random_fold_in(), random_clone() and random_wrap_key_data() return keys (raw keys stay raw); random_key_data() the uint32 key data; random_key_impl() the implementation name; random_key_dtype() the key dtype name.

Details

The implementations are "threefry2x32" (the default, see the option jax_default_prng_impl), "rbg" and "unsafe_rbg". The option jax_threefry_partitionable (default TRUE) selects the threefry split and bits algorithms, as in JAX.
